title: API service
description: RED metrics, Node.js runtime, database, cache, external calls and degraded features of the API, from its OpenTelemetry metrics (docs/observability.md#metrics).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: API responses per second, every route and status.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of the responses that were 5xx: what the availability SLO counts.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the response time, every route.

panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: API processes that pushed metrics in the last 5 minutes (one per service.instance.id).

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Responses per second per route pattern (/api/users/:id).

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Responses per second by status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx).

panels.title: Error ratio by status class
panels.description: Share of the responses that were 4xx (client errors: validation, authentication, not found) and 5xx (server errors).

panels.title: 5xx ratio by route
panels.description: Share of each route's responses that were 5xx.

panels.title: p50 latency by route
panels.description: 50th percentile of the API response time per route pattern, from the buckets of http.server.request.duration. Health probes are never measured.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: 95th percentile of the API response time per route pattern, from the buckets of http.server.request.duration. Health probes are never measured.

panels.title: p99 latency by route
panels.description: 99th percentile of the API response time per route pattern, from the buckets of http.server.request.duration. Health probes are never measured.

panels.title: 5xx by origin
panels.description: Server errors per second by where they came from: application (a bug), database, dependency (an external service or Redis), unavailable (deliberate 503: readiness, shutdown).

panels.title: Readiness failures by instance
panels.description: GET /api/health/ready answered 503 (database unreachable, required Redis down, shutting down). Alert: ApiReadinessFailing.

panels.title: Event loop delay
panels.description: How late the event loop runs its timers: every request waits this long. p99 above 200 ms for 15 minutes alerts (ApiEventLoopDelayHigh).

panels.title: Event loop utilization
panels.description: Share of the time the event loop was busy (1 = saturated).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time used per second (1 = one core), user and system. Compare with the container's CPU limit.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size (what the container's memory limit counts) and the V8 heap in use.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Seconds spent in garbage collection per second, by kind.

panels.title: Active handles
panels.description: Sockets, timers and other libuv handles kept open: a steady climb is a leak.

panels.title: Query p95 by operation
panels.description: PostgreSQL statement duration, 95th percentile, by operation (SELECT, INSERT...).

panels.title: Queries by operation
panels.description: PostgreSQL statements per second, by operation.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Connections of the pg pool in use and idle, its maximum (DB_POOL_MAX) and the requests waiting for one (ApiDatabasePoolSaturated alerts after 5 minutes).

panels.title: Slow queries
panels.description: Statements slower than DB_SLOW_QUERY_MS, per minute; each one is logged with its statement (never its values).

panels.title: Cache reads by result
panels.description: CacheService reads per second: hit, miss, error (an error is served as a miss).

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by namespace
panels.description: Share of the reads of each cache namespace served from the cache.

panels.title: Redis command p95
panels.description: node-redis command duration, 95th percentile, by command.

panels.title: Redis client errors
panels.description: Errors node-redis reported per second, by type (network errors while Redis is down).

panels.title: External calls by outcome
panels.description: Calls through the shared external HTTP client per second, by dependency and outcome (success, http_error, timeout, network_error), retries included.

panels.title: External call p95 by dependency
panels.description: Duration of a call with its retries, 95th percentile, per dependency.

panels.title: Outgoing HTTP p95 by host
panels.description: Every outgoing HTTP request the process makes (fetch and http), the OTLP export itself included, 95th percentile per server.

panels.title: Degraded operations
panels.description: Operations served by a fallback because an optional dependency was unavailable (rate limits per instance, cache misses), per second. ApiDegradedMode alerts after 5 minutes.
